title: Figma panel kit and token orchestration for cost dashboards & rollout controls
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: create a cohesive Figma panel kit and token orchestration focused on cost dashboards and rollout controls so engineers and PMs can compose panels with predictable spacing, accessible color semantics, and consistent interactive patterns. This ticket covers token naming conventions (color, elevation, motion, spacing), atomic components for ledger-like cost rows, compact/expanded rollout controls, and production-ready Figma components with variants, auto-layout rules, and usage documentation.

Progress:
- Initial token catalog draft completed (colors, neutral scales, brand accents) and uploaded to Figma.
- Prototype created for two panel sizes: Compact (dense list) and Card (metric+trend). Preview links in attachments.
- Accessibility pass (contrast checks and keyboard focus states) done for key components; outstanding for disabled/low-contrast badges.
- Eng sync held with Frontend infra on 2026-03-11; agreed on token keys and CSS variable mapping strategy.

Trade-offs / open questions:
- Whether to include two separate elevation token families (dashboard-elevation vs control-elevation) or unify into a single semantic set. We lean semantic (surface-1 / surface-2) but need eng validation for shadow perf.
- Micro-interaction timing: 120ms vs 160ms for rollout toggles. 120ms is snappier but less friendly for motion-reduced users — will add reduced-motion variant.

Stakeholder feedback:
- PM (Caroline Reyes) asked for a tighter default compact row height to save vertical real estate in cost tables.
- Observability lead requested an explicit token for error/alert borders used in rollout failure states.

Next steps: finish variant naming, finalize token export sheet, and hand off a trimmed Figma kit for frontend implementation.

Links to artifacts and references are in attachments.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library published with namespaced tokens: --rdw-color-*, --rdw-space-*, --rdw-elevation-* (documented in token sheet)
Component set includes: CostRow (compact/expanded), CostSummaryCard, RolloutSwitch (primary/secondary/disabled), RolloutTimeline, ToastAlert (success/error/warning), and LedgerTable header
All components have auto-layout rules and responsive variants for <480px, 480-1024px, >1024px
Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text and >= 3:1 for subtle metadata; keyboard focus styles present and usable
Design export page listing mapping to frontend variables and example usage for dashboards and rollout flows
Engineering team has initial PR reference and an agreed mapping plan for CSS variables/ tokens
decisions: Use semantic surface tokens instead of feature-specific elevation tokens (surface-1, surface-2)
Adopt reduced-motion variant by default when OS-level preference is set
Name tokens with rdw- prefix and publish CSS variable mapping for infra
tasks: Finalize disabled/low-contrast badge palette and rerun contrast checks
Add keyboard-only visible focus ring and document token guidelines
Create example usage pages in Figma for cost dashboard and rollout flow
Export token JSON and provide sample CSS variables for frontend team
Follow-up eng sync to review PR mapping and shadow perf concerns
notes: During handoff meeting on 2026-03-13, eng raised performance concerns for complex layered shadows on low-end GPUs; suggested a flattened elevation token fallback. We'll include a fallback sheet in exports. Also flagged need for unit test cases for microcopy length in CostRow to prevent overflow.
